# kapsel-cli golden `or-true`. Regenerate with KAPSEL_BLESS=1.
# kapsel -c false || true
--- input
false || true
--- stderr (exit 65)
error[KS-R001]: `|| true` turns any failure of the command before it into success and destroys the error signal; let the command fail, or stop with `|| exit 1`
 --> -c:1:7
  |
1 | false || true
  |       ^^^^^^^
  |
  = note: `|| true` hides the exit status the next step or the caller needs to know the work failed (REQ-KS-012)
  = note: any right-hand side of `||` whose status is always 0 does the same: `:`, `exit 0`, `! false`, a constant-true `test`, a pipeline with a `true` stage, a loop whose body always ends with status 0
  = help: drop the `|| true` and let the command fail, or stop on the failure: `cmd || exit 1`; if the failure is expected, test for its cause first: `test -e stale.lock && rm stale.lock`
